FIELDS.NAME: HeatWave Boiler & Furnace Services
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Inspector, HeatWave Boiler & Furnace Services, (555) 123-4567
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
HeatWave Boiler & Furnace Services specializes in the installation, maintenance, and repair of residential and light commercial heating systems, including boilers and furnaces. Our team of certified technicians is committed to delivering high-quality service, ensuring that all installations and repairs comply with local, state, and federal safety regulations and building codes. We prioritize safety with rigorous training, including OSHA certification, for all employees and subcontractors. Our operations include routine maintenance contracts, emergency repair services during peak seasons, and the installation of energy-efficient upgrades like programmable thermostats. We maintain strong vendor relationships with reputable suppliers to ensure the use of approved parts and equipment. Additionally, we uphold strict documentation practices for safety protocols, maintenance logs, and incident reporting to enhance our commitment to safety and regulatory compliance. Our goal is to provide our customers with reliable heating solutions while ensuring a safe working environment for our team.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in any work involving demolition, structural alterations, or the removal of building components, and confirms a strict policy against handling, removal, or abatement of asbestos, lead paint, or other hazardous materials. Our operations are limited solely to residential and light commercial environments, and we ensure that all employees and subcontractors maintain current OSHA and industry-required safety training.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss Date: 03/10/2023; Cause: Minor leak in residential boiler during routine maintenance; Amount: $2,000; Status: Paid.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM; Saturday, 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM; Closed Sunday
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Chain link fencing and on-site watchpersons during installation and repair activities to ensure security and compliance with safety protocols.
